tools.name: mandate_draft_schema
tools.description: Returns the v0 Capital Authority Mandate draft template, the never-delegable act list, and the digest convention, so an agent can construct a draft its principal will mint at capital.new.

tools.name: ceremony_info
tools.description: Returns where and how a mandate draft becomes an instrument. Minting, signing, and revocation are human ceremonies at https://capital.new — agents draft and verify; humans authorize.
